description: Build a compact Memory Autopilot brief for the current coding task. Schedules Code Memory refresh when needed, includes Start here files, reliable code-bound memories, stale/suspect cautions, and verification hints. Use this at the start of a new coding turn or after switching tasks.

format.description: Output format. "prompt" is agent-ready; "summary" is human-readable; "receipt" is bounded JSON; "json" is detailed diagnostics.
